p.title: The regime drift alert called a move inside one Fear & Greed zone severe, and used old VIX names
p.symptom: 55 -> 44.6 was 'severe' (raw 55/45 comparison) while both ends read as the neutral zone after rounding; the alert, the home status, the chat tag and the macro-tech bar called the same VIX 'panic', 'caution', 'normal' or 'fear' with 15/20/25/30 edges.
p.root_cause: Opposite-side logic compared raw numbers while labels used rounded zones; several files kept their own VIX word lists.
p.fix: Opposite sides are judged on zone indices; all legacy VIX words come from the shared names (low-volatility, normal, boundary, high-volatility); factor-weights recognises the new high-volatility name.
p.violated_rule: One VIX band set and one F&G zone set (P1534).
p.prevention: Legacy T791b (same zone is not severe, opposite zones are, VIX names).
